Name: (CP) Meowbox - Cat Ears For Your Mailbox
Author: StarfallStorms
Description:
[size=3]Introducing the Meowbox! Have you ever looked at your mailbox and thought that it needed cat ears? Well, now it can have them! 

Meowbox simply adds a pair of cat ears and whiskers to your mailbox using [/size][size=3][url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/size]

[size=5]Installation:[/size]
[size=3] 1. Make sure you have the latest versions of both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size][size=3] installed.
 2. Download the Meowbox mod file and ﻿unzip the folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
 3. Run the game through SMAPI

[/size][size=3]Enjoy your new mailbox![/size]
